title: Fewer Filipinos feel safe after dark despite high law and order score

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Despite a high law and order score in the latest Global Safety Report published by analytics company Gallup, fewer Filipinos feel safe walking alone at night in their communities. Citing data from the report, Dr. Alicor Panao, an associate professor at the University of the Philippines, said 64%, or more than six in 10 people, believe they are safe after dark, a figure that may seem “less alarming … at first glance.” However, Panao, a data scientist for the Inquirer, stressed that compared with the global average of 73% and the Asia-Pacific average of 79%, the Philippines “fares […]...
